text: that are younger than I: Heb. of fewer days than I
solitary: Or, dark as the night | in former time: Heb. yesternight
base men: Heb. men of no name
and spare not to spit in my face: Heb. and withhold not spittle from my face
my soul: Heb. my principal one
become cruel: Heb. turned to be cruel | thy strong hand: Heb. the strength of thy hand
for him that was in trouble?: Heb. for him that was hard of day
